description: Automatically extracted partial collection. Bibliometric sources and dates remain attached to each profile.
scopeNote: The real collection contains 14 institutions in scope and excludes Saegis. An institution without collected profiles is not an institution without academic staff.
q1Methodology: No documented Q1 policy has been supplied. Missing counts remain unknown; no counts are inferred from Scholar totals.
limitations: Not an exhaustive national census. Extracted facts and employment require factual review.
Name variants and cross-institution appointments may be duplicated.
Indexed ResearchGate snapshots may be stale and are not interchangeable with Google Scholar totals.
Qualification and teaching evidence can be incomplete. A title such as Dr is not evidence of a PhD.
No collected values for: h-index, exact five-year citations, Q1 publications, five-year Q1 publications.
Country identifies the awarding institution, not necessarily the physical location of study.
